rationale: S-0068-02 proposes M-current (KCNQ / Kv7) co-expression with Nav1.6 on the deposited Poleg-Polsky DSGC soma. t0074 (channel_tuning_width_bed_a) covers this by including Kv7 in the eight-channel set at low / medium / high densities, with the same 12-angle tuning curve per condition. The Kv7 MOD file vendoring is part of t0074's implementation scope; t0075 (bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep) inherits the vendored Kv7 mechanism for AIS-localised insertion. Rejecting as covered.
